headline: Datavault AI shares plummet 50% after losing access to Bitcoin reserves
summary: Datavault AI shares plunged 50% after the firm announced an accounting correction reducing reported assets by $92.2 million because bitcoin held on Biconomy could not be withdrawn.
why: Digital asset treasury holdings and platform dependency are critical risk factors for cryptocurrency-linked corporate entities.

impacts.name: Datavault AI
impacts.why: Loss of access to primary crypto assets and a $92.2 million write-down directly impairs corporate asset value and equity pricing.

why_moved: A major asset freeze and substantial write-down fundamentally alter a company's balance sheet strength, triggering immediate sell-offs.
